description: This is an abstract PHP test case class for integration testing API endpoints in the OrangeHRM system. It provides utility methods to populate test data, retrieve test cases, mock API endpoints, validate responses, and manage dependencies during test execution.

classes.name: EndpointIntegrationTestCase
classes.description: An abstract class providing utility functions for integration testing REST API endpoints within the OrangeHRM human resource management system.

methods.name: populateFixtures
methods.description: Populates database fixtures for testing from specified fixture files.

methods.name: getTestCases
methods.description: Loads test cases from fixture files, returning an array of test case parameters.

methods.name: getApiEndpointMock
methods.description: Creates a mock of the API endpoint class with specified request parameters for testing.

methods.name: assertValidTestCase
methods.description: Validates an API response against expectations, including response data, meta, and exception handling.

methods.name: assertServicesInitialized
methods.description: Asserts that required services and factories are properly initialized during the test.

methods.name: registerServices
methods.description: Registers specified services and factories into the dependency container for testing.

methods.name: getMockAuthUser
methods.description: Creates a mock authenticated user with specified user parameters for testing authorization and user-related features.

methods.name: registerMockDateTimeHelper
methods.description: Mocks the date/time helper service to return a fixed date/time during tests.
